name: @ductura/server
description: Ductura zajednički API: prijava AAI@EduHr, ovlasti, baza i pozadinski poslovi

scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:property && pnpm test:integration
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres-main postgres-logs && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:provision: docker compose exec -T postgres-main psql -U ductus -d ductus -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < db/main/local/migrator.sql
scripts.db:provision:app: docker compose exec -T postgres-main psql -U ductus -d ductus -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < db/main/local/app-login.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres-main psql -U ductus -d ductus -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < db/main/local/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:main: pnpm db:provision && node scripts/db/migrate-locked.ts --url "postgres://ductus:ductus-local-only@127.0.0.1:54329/ductus?sslmode=disable&role=ductus_migrator" && pnpm db:provision:app && pnpm db:provision:worker && pnpm db:provision:auth
scripts.db:provision:logs: docker compose exec -T postgres-logs psql -U ductus -d ductus_logs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < db/logs/local/migrator.sql
scripts.test:db: docker compose exec -T postgres-main pg_prove -U ductus -d ductus --recurse --ext .sql /db/tests
